name: opencode-skill-audit
description: Audit trail of skill invocations and file changes, with a live timeline in the opencode sidebar

scripts.format: prettier --write src test package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json eslint.config.js .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json eslint.config.js .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.build:index: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target bun --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/sdk
scripts.build:tui: bun build src/tui.ts --outfile dist/tui.js --target bun --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/solid --external solid-js
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:types && bun run build:index && bun run build:tui
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:test && bun test && ./test/format-contract.sh
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check:versions && bun run check && bun run build
